newsitem.title: USA: Bloomfield, Conn schools seek 1.7 pct budget boost.
newsitem.headline: Bloomfield, Conn schools seek 1.7 pct budget boost.

text.p: Bloomfield School Superintendent Paul Copes is recommending a 1997-98 budget that would increase spending by 1.7 percent, the Hartford Courant reported on Wednesday.
Copes' proposed budget of $22.4 million is $381,268 higher than the current year's budget, and the increase would be far smaller than the 12 percent he sought last year, the paper said.
The approved budget ended up at $22.1 million, about 2 percent higher than the previous budget.
The budget proposal is lean on new programs, with Copes ordering his staff to concentrate on making the budget more efficient instead of bigger.
The school board is expected to discuss the budget proposal for the first time on Wednesday night, the paper said.
